scenarios.name: the owner's acts: start (and its refusals), correct (a retry, a stale count), sold, the low mark, stop
a sale is a target: the same again takes nothing, a larger one the difference, a shortfall is noted, a cancel gives back only what was taken
a delivery is the total received so far: a part, then the rest, the same mark again, a unit that is not the count's, a line taking its first delivery's unit
reconcileDeliveries: goods before counting began move nothing, a later mark adds the difference, a refused unit is reported once per quantity
reconcileSales and the holds not yet booked: standing orders are booked, cancelled given back, history never moves the count
the low mark once per crossing: an alert per crossing, asked counted, acked once, cleared above the mark, the request id; tidy forgets old keys and alerts
